scenes.title: Friday night
scenes.purpose: Hook: a wall of 647 government systems lights up, an ember takes hold, and the whole wall dims outward from the fire.
scenes.narration: On Friday night, September twenty-sixth, twenty twenty-five, a fire broke out in a government data center in Day-jun, South Korea. Across the country, public services began to go dark.
scenes.visual: Tiles lay out row by row; the date types in; an ember glows at the lower left and the nearest tiles catch; then every tile goes grey in a wave away from the fire.

layout.portrait: Wall or art in the upper 60% inside the safe area; large numerals and one support line below, above the bottom UI zone.

beats.action: 647 tiles lay out row by row
wall dims outward from the fire

transition_out.continuity: the dimmed wall fades as the building cutaway draws on

scenes.title: Batteries on the move
scenes.purpose: Show where and how it began, and keep the cause an open question.
scenes.narration: It began in a fifth-floor server room, where lithium-ion batteries were being moved to the basement. Sparks, then smoke, then flames. Why it happened was still under investigation.
scenes.visual: Line-art cutaway: five floors and a basement. Batteries are carried down the stair shaft; sparks, then smoke, then flames on the fifth floor; a question mark and a 'cause: under investigation' stamp.

layout.portrait: Wall or art in the upper 60% inside the safe area; large numerals and one support line below, above the bottom UI zone.

beats.action: building draws on, fifth floor highlighted
three batteries carried to the basement

transition_out.continuity: the wall returns for the count

scenes.title: 647 systems, one building
scenes.purpose: Scale of the outage: 647 systems, 96 burned, 551 shut down as a precaution, and the services citizens lost.
on_screen_text: Sources: Asia News Network, Korea Times
scenes.narration: The building ran six hundred and forty-seven government systems. Ninety-six were burned. The other five hundred and fifty-one were shut down before the heat could reach them. Government websites, Korea Post and the mobile I-D app all went offline.
scenes.visual: The wall returns lit; a counter rolls to 647; the 96 tiles nearest the fire turn vermilion; the other 551 dim; three service rows are stamped Offline.

layout.portrait: Wall or art in the upper 60% inside the safe area; large numerals and one support line below, above the bottom UI zone.

scenes.title: The drive with no copy
scenes.purpose: Explain why G-Drive was lost while other systems recovered: daily copies existed for most, none outside the building for G-Drive.
on_screen_text: Users: 125,000 to 750,000, depending on the report
Sources: Korea JoongAng Daily, Korea Times, DCD
scenes.narration: Most systems had daily backups, including a copy at a remote site. One did not. Gee Drive, where civil servants had stored their work since twenty eighteen, held about eight hundred and fifty-eight terabytes. Officials said its design allowed no outside copy. When the room burned, it was gone.
scenes.visual: Two shelves: Daejeon above, a remote site below. Five folders send dashed arrows and their copies land below. The large G-Drive folder has an empty dashed slot beneath it and a 'no outside copy' stamp; 858 TB counts up; flames take the top shelf; the copies stay.

layout.portrait: Wall or art in the upper 60% inside the safe area; large numerals and one support line below, above the bottom UI zone.

beats.action: five folders on the top shelf
copies slide to the remote shelf

transition_out.continuity: shelves fade; the wall returns in its burned state

scenes.title: Weeks to come back
scenes.purpose: Recovery in three dated checkpoints, with G-Drive rebuilt only from what survives.
on_screen_text: 6 days later · 2 Oct · 112 of 647 services back
Sources: Korea Times (2, 31 Oct), JoongAng Daily (14 Nov)
scenes.narration: The rest came back slowly. Six days later, seventeen percent. By the end of October, eighty-nine. Forty-nine days after the fire, ninety-eight. But Gee Drive's files could only be rebuilt from emails, personal computers and paper.
scenes.visual: The burned and dimmed wall turns blue in seeded random order: 17%, 89%, 98.2%. Then three source icons (email, computer, paper) send dashed lines to an outlined G-Drive folder that fills only partially.

layout.portrait: Wall or art in the upper 60% inside the safe area; large numerals and one support line below, above the bottom UI zone.

beats.action: G-Drive outline and three source icons

transition_out.continuity: wall fades; four figures draw on

scenes.title: A copy somewhere else
scenes.purpose: Accountability is still open; the lesson is a copy in another place. End on a held title.
on_screen_text: Booked on suspicion of professional negligence
A backup is a copy somewhere else.
The Day South Korea Lost Its Digital Memory
scenes.narration: Police booked four people on suspicion of negligence. A booking is not a verdict. The lesson is older than any data center: a backup is a copy somewhere else.
scenes.visual: Four outlined faceless figures with 'booked on suspicion of professional negligence' and a 'Not a verdict' stamp; they leave; a folder here and its blue copy sliding to a far shelf along a dashed line; the closing line and title hold.

layout.portrait: Wall or art in the upper 60% inside the safe area; large numerals and one support line below, above the bottom UI zone.

beats.action: copy slides to a far shelf
